query: I work from home and need headphones that block out noise from my family. What should I get?
concepts: wired backup option for zero-latency calls
plausible_answers: Answer A (Sony XM5 Default): Get the Sony WH-1000XM5 — the best ANC performance available, excellent call quality, and 30-hour battery make it the top work-from-home headphone for blocking out household noise.

Answer B (Bose QC45 for Comfort): Choose the Bose QuietComfort 45 if you wear headphones for 6+ hours daily — its all-day comfort advantage over the Sony XM5 matters more than the marginal ANC performance difference for heavy users.

Answer C (Jabra for Call Quality): Buy the Jabra Evolve2 75 if call clarity is your primary need — its professional-grade microphone array produces noticeably better audio for meeting participants than any consumer-focused headphone.
